# Make the Request Reusable

## What Changes?

For one weekly chart, we want:

week + year -> one weekly chart dataframe

## Build `get_top_tracks()`

```{r}
YOUR_CODE_HERE

  tracks_raw <-
    request("https://api.music-to-scrape.org") |>
    req_url_path_append(
      "charts",
      "top-tracks"
    ) |>
    req_url_query(
      week = YOUR_CODE_HERE,
      year = YOUR_CODE_HERE,
      limit = 100
    ) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json()

  tracks_raw$chart |>
    bind_rows() |>
    select(
      name,
      artist,
      plays
    ) |>
    mutate(
      week = YOUR_CODE_HERE,
      year = YOUR_CODE_HERE
    )

YOUR_CODE_HERE
```

# Vary More Than One Input

## Build Week-Year Combinations

```{r}
week_years <-
  expand_grid(
    week = 42:44,
    year = 2023:2024
  )
```

```{r}
week_years
```

## Repeat with `map2()`

```{r}
results <-
  map2(
    YOUR_CODE_HERE,
    YOUR_CODE_HERE,
    YOUR_CODE_HERE
  )
```

## Combine the Results

```{r}
tracks_small <-
  results |>
  list_rbind()
```

# Scale Up

## All Weeks and Years

```{r}
week_years <-
  expand_grid(
    week = 1:52,
    year = 2022:2026
  )
```

## Collect the Full Dataset

```{r}
tracks <-
  map2(
    YOUR_CODE_HERE,
    YOUR_CODE_HERE,
    YOUR_CODE_HERE
  ) |>
  list_rbind()
```
